Family road trip · Winter school holidays · 2027

Melbourne ⇄
Brisbane

Up the coast, back through the inland. Snow, whales, rainforest, koalas and dark skies, paced for two adults, two kids under ten and one RAV4.

21days, 25 Jun – 15 Jul (1 buffer)
19nights away, 12 overnight stops
~4,350km, estimate (4,250–4,450)
~52 hdriving, estimate (51–54)

Stops

·Fri 25 Jun · stopover, no overnightPhoto↑

Mt Beauty stopover

Kiewa Valley · 20–30 min photo and leg stretch

Drive
Melbourne → Mt Beauty → Falls Creek~4 h to Mt Beauty, then ~35–40 min up to the resort to confirm
Do
  • Hero shot: town in the valley under Mount Bogong, from Sullivans Lookout on Tawonga Gap Rd
  • Fuel and snow-chain hire here, as the resort has no fuel
Stay
Not overnight, unless snow is poor: Mt Beauty cabins as the base for Falls Creek day tripsCabins and rates not researched (unverified)

to confirm Lookout access and the best drive-in direction

01Fri 25 – Sat 26 JunS↑

Falls Creek

Alpine snow · two days · 2 nights

Drive
Melbourne → Mt Beauty (photo stop) → Falls Creek~4.5–5 h incl. stopover to confirm
Do
  • Snow play both days: toboggan runs, Slalom Plaza
  • Chains must be carried; check the road report
  • No fuel in the resort: fill up at Mt Beauty
  • If snow is poor: base in Mt Beauty and day-trip up, or swap to Mt Buller
Stay
Falls Creek, 2 nights (unverified). No Accor in the resort; Schuss Lodge is closed Oct 2026 – May 2027Alt: Tivoli Ski Club lodge, winter from $110 per adult/night (unverified; check non-member access). Fallback: Mt Beauty cabins (unverified)

to confirm Snow depth in late June; lodge and cabin availability

02Sun 27 JunS↑

Canberra

Australian Capital Territory · 1 night

Drive
Falls Creek → Corryong → Tumut → Canberra~5.5–6 h · fallback via Hume/Albury ~5 h to confirm
Do
  • Questacon, the hands-on science centre (~2–3 h on the morning of 28 Jun)
  • Leave around midday for the coast
Stay
Mercure Canberra, Braddon (Accor; family friendly, parking)Alt: Novotel Canberra (pool) · The Sebel Canberra (kitchenettes)

to confirm Questacon opening hours

03Mon 28 – Tue 29 JunS↑

Jervis Bay · Huskisson

NSW South Coast · 2 nights

Drive
Canberra → Huskisson~2.5–3 h, after Questacon to confirm
Do
  • Whale-watching cruise (humpbacks, July), dolphins often seen
  • Hyams Beach, white sand (~20 min walk)
  • Booderee and Cape St George lookouts, Huskisson bakery
Stay
Holiday Haven Huskisson Beach cabin, about $110–$260 (book early, fills in holidays)Alt: Jervis Bay Holiday Park (Tasman), quieter, out of town

to confirm Cruise operator and live rates

Plan B & checks

Swaps

  • Snow fails or chains risky: Mt Buller day, or Mt Beauty cabins with day trips, then Hume via Albury to Canberra
  • Jenolan closed: Wentworth Falls, Scenic World, Three Sisters
  • Coast weather bad: add a Sydney day (Taronga / Manly ferry)

Trim

  • Cut a night: drop the 2nd night at Jervis Bay or Port Stephens
  • Faster return: Brisbane → Dubbo → home via the Newell, home 13 Jul
  • School: Vic Term 3 starts 12 Jul, so 12–14 Jul are missed

Confirm before booking

  • Whale and dolphin cruise operators and seasons; kids' age limits
  • Jenolan, Scenic World and Siding Spring hours; Tangalooma in winter
  • Falls Creek snow cover, alpine road reports, Springbrook roads; all July rates
